title: デビュー戦の後に・フライト延長希望！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun has successfully made her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite how much she admired the Twinkle Series, she finds the races she's competed in so far to be more boring than expected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The difference between her dreams and reality has her in a tailspin. But she's still at the debut level. If she's able to run in more races, I'm sure she'll change her mind…
